title: Argus feature spec contract
description: The machine-readable half of a feature spec (spec.json). The prose half (spec.md) carries acceptance criteria and component contracts the judge reads as 'spec-text'. Keeping the contract as JSON (not YAML front matter) removes the parser dependency and lets spec_lint.py validate with stdlib only.

feature.description: Feature slug. Spec lives at argus/specs/{feature}/.

adapter.description: Which sensor+gates adapter renders this feature: 'web' | 'ios' | a custom adapter name. See references/adapter-contract.md.

tokens.description: Path (repo-relative) to the generated read-only tokens.json manifest. Single source of truth for the design-system-anchored dimensions.

contrast_pairs.description: Path to contrast-pairs.json for the token_contrast gate.

targets.description: The renderable units (screens / views / pages) the loop converges, one at a time.

route.description: How the adapter reaches this target. Web: a URL/path. iOS: an 'app://feature/target' deep route. Opaque to the loop; interpreted by the adapter.

states.description: Render states the fixture harness can actually produce, e.g. ['empty','populated']. Do NOT list 'loading'/'error' unless a fixture renders them.

appearances.description: Appearances to sign off, e.g. ['light','dark']. Default ['light'].

fixtures.description: Map of state -> deterministic data-fixture name the adapter injects before rendering. Renders are judged against fixtures, never live data.

canonical.description: The single state+appearance that needs a reference image. Other state/appearance deltas are described in spec.md prose (keeps human input at <=1 reference/target). Defaults to states[0]+appearances[0].

a11y_contract.description: Element ids the probe must find on this target (existing scheme, documented as-found, never invented). A '*' suffix matches a prefix family, e.g. 'row.habit.*'.

references.description: Reference manifest. <=1 'present' entry per target is the canonical composition target; others are deltas described in prose.

status.description: present=file exists (gates loop); needed=HE worklist; candidate=agent render awaiting approval.

source.description: Recorded into signoff.json so a candidate-bootstrapped sign-off is not read as bespoke design approval.

file.description: Path under the feature's references/ dir, named {target}-{state}-{appearance}.png.

component_contracts.description: Free-form per-state component expectations the judge reads as spec-text (e.g. 'each row shows a title, a streak count, and a complete button').
